goal: Run many intelligence modules without exploding query volume or losing source quality.

batches.queryStrategy: broad topic terms first, then exact title or identifier verification
batches.reason: Public science and AI sources are API-friendly and should build the evidence base before market interpretation.

batches.queryStrategy: entity watchlist aliases plus product, trial, regulatory, launch, partnership, evidence, AI, anti-aging terms
batches.reason: Competitor modules should search named A-level entities first instead of broad web queries.

batches.queryStrategy: product availability, evidence page, regulatory page, ingredient launch, formulation and dosage terms
batches.reason: Application and ingredient items are useful after core and competitor signals are known.

batches.queryStrategy: run only when patent credentials are configured; never infer no activity from missing credentials
batches.reason: Patent searches are costly and should not block the public weekly when credentials are unavailable.

searchNarrowing.entityQueryTemplate: ("{alias}" OR "{displayName}") ({moduleTerms}) (launch OR clinical trial OR patent OR ingredient OR evidence OR AI OR partnership OR regulatory)
